LuLu’s Annual Wedding Vow Renewal Ceremony will be Saturday, Feb 14th from 1-3pm. All locations.

Join us all day on Sundays at LuLu's North Myrtle Beach, SC in Barefoot Landing for the NFL Sunday Ticket. We will have weekly featured games with the sound on, and all other games on various TVs. Make plans to join us!

LuLu’s Gulf Shores Beach Arcade offers fun games for all ages. Come and enjoy a wide variety of redemption games and old-school favorites.

Hours of Operation: Open Daily 10:30am – 9::00pm

Caricature Artist

Golden Coconuts
Most companies have Employees of the Month, but here at LuLu’s we have Golden Coconuts! A coconut, or “golden nugget”, caught at a Zulu Mardi Gras Parade in New Orleans is the most prized possession of New Orleans Mardi Gras. Since our LuLu’s anniversary (company wide) is on Fat Tuesday, the same day that Zulu rolls, and given the powerful influence that the great city of New Orleans had and continues to have on Lucy Buffett, it was only fitting that the person that best exemplifies the spirit of LuLu’s be crowned the Coconut of the Month and be awarded their very own coconut! We have a Coconut of the Month at each location and each year we crown a Coconut of the Year of all the monthly winners!

Got Questions?
If you can’t find the question you’d like to ask below, reach out to us!
How do I book a private party or special event?
LuLu’s is a large open-air restaurant without a private room to rent. We do host some large parties and events in our shoulder season, October through February. To be directed to the correct person, please email Info@LuLusFunFoodMusic.com and state which location (Destin, Gulf Shores, or North Myrtle Beach) you are looking to obtain information.
Are dogs allowed?
We love our fur babies however, only registered service animals are allowed at this time.
How do I get the locals’ deals & specials?
Next time you are at LuLu’s, ask your server for a Locals Card! Start collecting 10% Credits on all Food & Beverage purchases in addition to monthly Specials, such as, Free Cup of Gumbo, $3 off Desserts, Merchandise deals and more! Be sure to include your email when you sign up for your Locals Card so you can take advantage of a different special every month! (Don’t worry, you won’t get too many emails from us!)
Special hours of operation
We are open 7 Days a week at 11am Daily! (We are also Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day & New Years Day)
What is on the buffet?
The owner’s name is as close as we come to a “Buffet.”
Can you accommodate individuals with food allergies?
Yes! View our allergy menus. Our kitchens are 100% nut-free, so you won’t see a tree nut or peanut allergy menu!
Do you sell gift cards?
Yes! Visit our online store here!
Can you accommodate large parties?
Yes! We can accommodate parties of all sizes.
Do you have a military discount?
We do! We want to thank our service men and women with a 10% discount on food and non-alcoholic beverages.
Is LuLu’s Wheelchair Accessible?
Yes! All of our locations are ADA compliant.

Easter Egg Dash – All Locations

UPDATE: LuLu’s Annual Easter Egg Dash for DESTIN and GULF SHORES has been changed to Saturday, April 4 12-2PM

Join us for LuLu’s Annual Easter Egg Dash on Sunday, April 5 from 12–2 PM in North Myrtle Beach and April 4 12-2PM in Gulf Shores and Destin! This family-friendly Easter event features photos with the Easter Bunny, live music, and our famous Easter Egg Dash starting at 1 PM, where kids ages 1–14 race across the sand to collect thousands of hidden eggs. It’s not a hunt — it’s a dash!

In addition to the egg dash, enjoy live music all day, family fun, and special promotions including $5 Mimosa and Bloody Mary drink specials, merchandise deals like 2 children’s T-shirts for $22, and more! Golden eggs hidden among the dash eggs will also unlock free toys, arcade passes, and other surprises.

Guests are encouraged to bring their own Easter baskets (bags will be available if needed). Please note that parents are not allowed in the dash area for children ages 3 and up.

Celebrate Easter on the Gulf Coast with great food, live music, family activities, and one of the biggest Easter egg events around at LuLu’s!
